outcome.implementation_scope: Authority write preflight for dirty or shared checkouts with a same-session path-scoped worktree claim.
outcome.implementation_change: The evaluator recognizes a same-checkout and same-branch claim that does not cover the requested paths and returns an explicit scope-coverage defer with an actionable next step. It does not grant broader write eligibility or request owner approval.
outcome.verified_change: Regression tests verify a whole-worktree request is deferred with the new scope-mismatch status and an exact covered-path request is allowed under the same claim.
outcome.interpretation_limit: No subsequent live workflow has yet demonstrated that the clearer explanation reduces coordination work or prevents recurrence.

improvement_relation.basis: The original session event records the generic coordination defer. A follow-up exact-path authority preflight allowed the same writable session without persistent authority, and targeted tests verify the new scope-specific guidance and exact-path eligibility.
not_measured: whether future agents resolve this mismatch with fewer tool calls
whether the same mismatch recurs in other repositories
long-term agent intervention burden or integration quality
